newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP sees copper costs improving - paper.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP sees copper costs improving - paper.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd expects to see significant cost improvements in its copper division in the current financial quarter, The Australian newspaper said on Monday.

BHP has said that ballooning production costs, which had risen to around US$0.85 a pound at its Magma copper division in the U.S., coupled with a world slump in copper prices helped cut about A$150 million from its bottom line in the first quarter, ended September 30.
"I think there will be a significant improvement in this quarter's costs," Burgess Winter, chief executive of BHP's copper division said.
